title: J3 interrogate — tautological _auto_permit property
intent_under_review: Property-fuzz the judge cage so 10k adversarial trials prove permit sets never widen.

finding.summary: Default target used a stub _auto_permit oracle whose permit math was near-tautological. Ten thousand greens measured monotone stub arithmetic, not engine or cage containment of adversarial judge output.
finding.root_cause: _auto_permit compared synthetic permit sets that did not flow through evaluate_tool_call EvaluationResult.
finding.act_on: Replace the measured target with a real path (engine_eval_target) or stop claiming containment. Later honesty pass further named engine discard as a separate invariant from cage consult.

agreement: All three models independently called the stub-oracle property critical for the same reason.
transcript_anchor: agent-transcripts/fa39ec96-d057-45fc-acff-faf0ab247dd0 (assistant summary citing the three agent IDs)
follow_on: Commit 845e499 moved the default target to engine_eval_target. J3b honesty pass split ENGINE_DISCARD_INVARIANT from JUDGE_CAGE_INVARIANT so discard-identity is not sold as containment.
